rule: LÉLU is one identity with many looks. The face, hairline and body are fixed by PRIMARY_SOURCE; wardrobe family and hairstyle are swappable variables. Every look is captured in the same six views: front, left 3/4, left profile, back, right 3/4, right profile, plus a detail set.

style_families.name: Casual / Street
style_families.garments: oversized hoodie or jacket, fitted or ribbed base top, relaxed cargo trousers, utility pockets, chunky sneakers, drawcords
style_families.jewelry: rose-gold chain layers, small hoops, charm clips, belt hardware, understated rings
style_families.materials: fleece, jersey, cotton, washed denim, canvas, mesh

style_families.name: Reserved / Minimal
style_families.garments: high-neck knit or clean fitted top, longline coat, relaxed tailored trousers, clean low-profile footwear
style_families.jewelry: fine chain, small hoops, one pendant, slim rings, one hair pin or cuff
style_families.materials: rib knit, wool, cotton poplin, matte leather

style_families.name: Formal / Elegant
style_families.garments: structured suit, sculpted dress or gown, tailored jacket, internal corsetry, optional train, refined heels or dress boots
style_families.jewelry: gem pendant, drop earrings, layered fine chains, rings, hair ornament, belt clasp
style_families.materials: silk, satin, brocade, velvet, crepe, metallic trim

style_families.name: Steampunk / Industrial
style_families.garments: structured corset or waistcoat, layered blouse, fitted industrial jacket, harness belts, utility trousers or layered skirt, substantial boots
style_families.jewelry: goggles, gear pendant, copper chains, watch details, brass cuffs, riveted belt hardware, gemstone drops
style_families.materials: aged leather, brass, copper, canvas, brocade, mesh

style_families.name: Regal / Royal
style_families.garments: crown or diadem, embroidered robe or coat, structured bodice, layered trousers or gown, cape, overskirt or train, ornate footwear
style_families.jewelry: crown gems, medallions, shoulder chains, layered necklaces, brooches, jeweled combs, cuffs
style_families.materials: brocade, embroidered velvet, satin, metallic thread, fine mesh

style_families.name: Exotic / Cultural Fusion
style_families.direction: vibrant ornate editorial fusion, designed not claimed
style_families.garments: layered wrap panels, dramatic sleeves, mixed textile jacket, sculptural skirt or wide-leg trousers, street-couture footwear
style_families.jewelry: layered chains, gemstone drops, cuffs, floral clips, waist chains, textile-linked ornaments
style_families.materials: patterned textiles, embroidery, mesh, leather, velvet, metallic trims

style_families.name: Afrocentric / Diaspora
style_families.direction: contemporary Black cultural expression with provenance
style_families.garments: contemporary tailored or wrapped silhouettes, sculptural outer layer, woven or printed panels, utility styling kept distinct from ceremonial
style_families.jewelry: beadwork, copper/brass pieces, cuffs, braid ornaments, woven belts
style_families.materials: woven textures, cotton, linen, leather, beads, metallic thread

style_families.name: Asian-inspired / region-specific
style_families.direction: name the region; never blend regions into one costume
style_families.garments: kimono-inspired outer layer, hanbok-inspired volume, mandarin collar, sari-inspired drape, regional tailoring
style_families.jewelry: hairpins, combs, jeweled ornaments, chains, brooches, textile-specific closures
style_families.materials: silk, brocade, jacquard, cotton, lacquer-like finish

style_families.name: Indigenous / Earth
style_families.direction: researched by nation/community; no pan-Indigenous costume, feathers or headdress
style_families.garments: contemporary garments informed by researched regional shapes, functional layers, weather-ready pieces
style_families.jewelry: only community-appropriate researched adornments, silver/copper, beadwork
style_families.materials: natural fibers, woven cloth, leather, beadwork, metals with provenance
palette: earth palette or specified community palette

style_families.name: Futuristic / Cyber
style_families.direction: advanced techwear and luminous modular design
style_families.garments: technical coat, articulated panels, fitted underlayer, modular cargo trousers, translucent or reflective outer panels, sculptural boots
style_families.jewelry: integrated metal connectors, luminous accents, tech ear pieces, modular belt hardware, geometric pendants
style_families.materials: technical knit, reflective textile, translucent polymer-like panels, mesh, coated canvas

style_families.name: Ritual / Mythic Fantasy
style_families.direction: invented earth-connected symbolic fantasy, labelled as LÉLU worldbuilding
style_families.garments: layered robes and wraps, cape or mantle, protective outerwear, symbolic belt, fitted base layer, grounded footwear
style_families.jewelry: talismans, stones, botanical metalwork, symbolic embroidery
style_families.materials: natural textures, woven cloth, distressed canvas, leather, metalwork

style_families.name: Performance / Stage
style_families.garments: stage suit or bodysuit, detachable train, fringe or layered skirt, statement jacket, secure footwear
style_families.jewelry: secure body chains, stage earrings, cuffs, crystal accents, fastened hair ornaments
style_families.materials: stretch mesh, sequins, metallic textiles, stretch velvet, flexible trim

style_families.name: Modular / Transformable
style_families.garments: convertible jacket, detachable sleeves, reversible panels, swappable closures
style_families.jewelry: interchangeable charms, clip-on chains, modular belt hardware, swappable headpieces

hairstyles.name: Natural Afro Crown
hairstyles.shape: rounded halo silhouette, dense defined coils, shaped/tapered and high-volume options
hairstyles.ornaments: copper hair cuffs or small floral pins, sparing

hairstyles.name: Locs, waist length
hairstyles.shape: long individual locs, natural thickness variation, tapered ends, visible scalp pattern
hairstyles.ornaments: copper/rose-gold loc cuffs, beads, chain accents

hairstyles.name: Box braids, jeweled
hairstyles.shape: square or diamond parting, medium box braids, consistent taper
hairstyles.ornaments: braid cuffs, gemstone beads, end ornaments

hairstyles.name: Fulani braids with beads and rings
hairstyles.shape: central and side feed-in braid pattern, resolved scalp geometry, braid direction
hairstyles.ornaments: beads, rings, fine braid jewelry

hairstyles.name: Sculpted cornrows
hairstyles.shape: raised scalp braids with curved or geometric paths, tapering to a bun or braid fall
hairstyles.ornaments: minimal cuffs or one accent chain

hairstyles.name: Ornamented bantu knots
hairstyles.shape: multiple sectioned knots with dimensional coil wrapping, even spacing
hairstyles.ornaments: small copper rings, beads, floral pins

hairstyles.name: Goddess twists
hairstyles.shape: full rope twists with soft curly ends, long cascade, varied but coherent thickness
hairstyles.ornaments: rose-gold twist cuffs, tiny gemstones, flower accents

hairstyles.name: Japanese-inspired ornamental updo
hairstyles.shape: sculptural updo, clean silhouette, controlled tendrils, labelled as contemporary interpretation
hairstyles.ornaments: hair sticks, kanzashi-inspired floral pins

hairstyles.name: Hime cut
hairstyles.shape: long straight or softly textured hair, cheek/jaw-length side sections, fringe
hairstyles.ornaments: minimal clips or a single pin

hairstyles.name: Layered wolf cut
hairstyles.shape: layered crown volume, textured ends, face-framing layers, optional curtain fringe
hairstyles.ornaments: small ear cuffs or subtle clips

hairstyles.name: Indigenous-inspired braids
hairstyles.shape: researched nation-specific braiding; no generic pan-Indigenous styling
hairstyles.ornaments: community-appropriate only

hairstyles.name: Royal braid crown
hairstyles.shape: braided crown structure with controlled volume
hairstyles.ornaments: gem pins, medallion, fine chains

hairstyles.name: Braided high ponytail
hairstyles.shape: high ponytail with braided base and clean hairline
hairstyles.ornaments: cuff at the base, chain accent

hairstyles.name: Fusion space buns
hairstyles.shape: two high buns combining curls, braids or twists with loose face-framing texture
hairstyles.ornaments: small rings, twin pins, optional rose accents

hairstyles.name: Double ornamental buns
hairstyles.shape: twin buns with named regional research
hairstyles.ornaments: combs, pins or ribbons tied to the region

hairstyles.name: Sculptural loop updo
hairstyles.shape: interlocking hair loops and braided structures forming an architectural silhouette
hairstyles.ornaments: fine chains or gem pins at junctions

hairstyles.name: Half-up, half-down
hairstyles.shape: upper section braided, twisted or knotted; lower length loose in curls, coils or waves
hairstyles.ornaments: barrette, jeweled clip, braid cuff or flower cluster

hairstyles.name: Curly updo with tendrils
hairstyles.shape: pinned curls in a high or low updo with released tendrils at face and nape
hairstyles.ornaments: pearl/crystal pins, floral clips, small hair chains

hairstyles.name: Asymmetric sleek bob
hairstyles.shape: jaw-to-chin length bob with intentional side-to-side difference, controlled shine
hairstyles.ornaments: minimal ear jewelry, one optional side clip

hairstyles.name: Long straight silk finish
hairstyles.shape: long smooth straight hair, natural weight, clean part, waist or hip length
hairstyles.ornaments: fine hair chain, small clips or none

hairstyles.name: Defined curl pattern
hairstyles.shape: defined spring curls, visible strand grouping, controlled frizz, consistent curl scale
hairstyles.ornaments: subtle cuffs, flower pins, chain accents

hairstyles.name: Colour-accented curls
hairstyles.shape: dark base curls with rose, copper, plum or magenta accent sections, believable root transitions
hairstyles.ornaments: secondary only

hairstyles.name: Wild freeform locs
hairstyles.shape: organic freeform locs, varied thickness, irregular but intentional silhouette
hairstyles.ornaments: sparse loc jewelry, copper wraps, beads

hairstyles.name: Braided mohawk
hairstyles.shape: close braided sides with a raised central ridge, clean transitions, scalp pattern
hairstyles.ornaments: central chain, small rings, metallic braid cuffs

asset_classes: neck and chest: chokers, layered chains, torques, pendants, medallions, bib necklaces, body chains, sternum ornaments
ears: hoops, drops, cuffs, climbers, studs, ear chains, linked multi-piercing sets
hair and head: braid cuffs, loc rings, beads, hairpins, combs, floral pieces, crowns, headpieces
hands: rings, knuckle plates, cuffs, nail sets
waist and hips: belts, harnesses, D-rings, pouches, sashes, chain swags
feet and legs: platform boots, buckles, sole hardware, anklets, crystal drops
garment components: buckles, clasps, zippers, detachable panels, buckles, printed panels

verified_against.hair_framebook: 24 styles, 6 views per style incl. overhead/top
